turn_off.name: Turn off plugs
turn_off.description: Turn off managed plugs. Plugs labelled 常開 are always skipped.

area.name: Area
area.description: Only plugs in this area (area ID or name).

label.name: Label
label.description: Only plugs with this label name.

standby_only.name: Standby only
standby_only.description: Only plugs that are on but drawing less than the standby threshold.

remember.name: Remember as
remember.description: Remember which plugs were turned off, so restore can turn them back on.

restore.name: Restore plugs
restore.description: Turn back on the plugs remembered by turn_off that are still off.
